game_title: Rounding Range – Lava River Crossing Streak
game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Mt. Pyre – Lava River Crossing, a river of molten rock: the volcanologist must handle cinder bats while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Rounding Range: Use round() and abs() to snap messy measurements into valid slots.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Lava River Crossing: a river of molten rock
core_gameplay_loop: In Lava River Crossing, repeat each round: Use round() and abs() to snap messy measurements into valid slots. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the slot_matches value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 13 consecutive correct decisions about slot_matches to power up the volcanologist and open the forge anvil.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 9 (extended tier): Rounding Range
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how slot_matches changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cinder bats in Lava River Crossing.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 13.
